As an Edge AI Solution Architect, you will lead the design, development, and deployment of AI/ML solutions on embedded and edge computing platforms. You will work closely with customers, product teams, and engineering organizations to architect scalable Edge AI solutions that leverage hardware accelerators while maximizing performance, power efficiency, and deployment scalability.

  • Mentor engineering teams on AI optimization techniques, deployment best practices, and emerging Edge AI technologies.

Your Profile

  • 14+ years of experience in Embedded Systems, AI/ML Engineering, or Product Engineering.
  • Proven expertise in AI and Edge AI model development, optimization, and deployment.
  • Strong experience with embedded AI platforms such as NVIDIA Jetson, NXP i.MX, Qualcomm AI platforms, or equivalent ecosystems.
  • Deep understanding of machine learning, deep learning, computer vision, and edge inference technologies.
  • Hands-on experience optimizing AI models for constrained embedded devices and microcontroller-based systems.

  • Familiarity with cloud-to-edge integration models and hybrid AI deployment frameworks.
  • Understanding of security, scalability, and performance optimization in Edge AI ecosystems.

We value flexibility and support our employees with remote work options and adaptable schedules to maintain a healthy work-life balance.

Our inclusive culture brings together diverse professionals committed to growth, innovation, and excellence.

You'll have access to continuous learning opportunities and certifications in AI, Edge Computing, Embedded Systems, Cloud, and Digital Engineering.

We are looking for a Manager, IT Security to build, operate, and scale a secure, resilient, and audit-ready technology environment - with equal ownership across enterprise IT and information security.
Reporting to the COO, this is a builder-operator role. You will be hands-on in designing systems and processes while simultaneously building the team and structure to scale them. You will own the full spectrum - from internal infrastructure and endpoint management to security engineering, compliance programs, AI security governance, data protection (including DPO responsibilities), and the customer-facing trust posture that enables enterprise revenue.
This role carries a unique advantage and responsibility: you will be securing an organization whose own products - ZTNA, MFA, SSO, virtualization, MDM, biometric authentication, and a secure OS - are the building blocks of enterprise security. That means dogfooding our stack, shaping product security from the inside, and representing our security posture to customers who evaluate us as both a vendor and a security partner.
You will build a defensible security architecture aligned with our product philosophy - secure-by-design digital workspace, identity-first access, and zero-trust principles - while keeping the organization ahead of an evolving threat landscape shaped by AI-driven attacks, software supply chain risks, and increasingly sophisticated adversaries.


Core Ownership Areas
  • Internal IT and infrastructure
  • Security engineering and operations
  • AI and emerging technology security
  • Data protection and privacy (DPO)
  • Compliance and certification programs
  • Product and platform security
  • Customer and regulator-facing security posture


Key Responsibilities

1. Enterprise IT Infrastructure Leadership
  • Own and scale global IT operations - end-user computing, networks, cloud infrastructure, and office IT for a distributed workforce.
  • Dogfood our own product stack (ZTNA, MFA, SSO, MDM, virtualization) as the foundation of internal IT architecture - serving as both a validation environment and a reference implementation for customers.
  • Design secure, identity-driven enterprise architecture with conditional access, device posture enforcement, and zero-trust segmentation.
  • Drive adoption of zero-trust and least-privilege models across all infrastructure layers.
  • Ensure high availability, performance, and resilience of internal systems with defined SLA targets.
  • Implement cloud security posture management (CSPM) and cloud workload protection (CWPP) across cloud environments.


2. Security Strategy Operations
  • Define and execute the organizations information security strategy, aligned to business objectives and the evolving threat landscape.
    • Security operations center (SOC) - with AI-augmented monitoring, detection, and response.
    • Vulnerability management and patching with defined SLA-driven remediation timelines.
    • Identity and access governance across internal and product environments.
  • Establish threat-informed defense models aligned to frameworks like MITRE ATTCK.
  • Deploy and evolve AI-native security tooling for automated threat detection, anomaly identification, and intelligent alerting to reduce analyst burden and improve response times.


3. AI Emerging Technology Security
  • Own the security governance framework for AI/ML usage across the organization - both internal tools and product-embedded capabilities.
    • LLM-assisted phishing and deepfake-based social engineering.
    • Prompt injection, data exfiltration via AI tools, and model manipulation risks.
    • Shadow AI usage and ungoverned adoption of generative AI by employees.
  • Define acceptable use policies and technical controls for AI tools (e.g., data classification rules for LLM inputs, approved tool lists, access controls for model endpoints).
  • Evaluate and integrate AI-driven capabilities into the security operations stack - automated triage, behavioral analytics, predictive threat intelligence.
  • Stay current on regulatory developments related to AI governance and data protection (e.g., EU AI Act, emerging regional frameworks).


4. Product Platform Security
  • Partner with engineering to embed secure SDLC practices with security gates at each stage of the development lifecycle.
    • Authentication and authorization layers (MFA, SSO, biometric authentication).
    • ZTNA and VPN / VDI / workspace access components.
    • MDM and endpoint management services.
    • Secure OS and USB-based deployment surfaces.
    • API and cloud-native services.
  • Implement and mature:
    • SAST, DAST, SCA, and SBOM practices with automated integration into CI/CD pipelines.
    • Threat modeling (STRIDE or equivalent) as a standard practice for new features and architecture changes.
  • Own software supply chain security - dependency integrity, build pipeline security, and provenance verification.
  • Act as the internal authority on customer-facing product security posture - particularly critical given that our products are themselves security tools evaluated by CISOs and security teams.


5. Data Protection, Privacy Security (DPO)
  • Serve as the organizations Data Protection Officer (DPO), with accountability for data privacy compliance across all 12 operating countries.
  • Define and enforce data classification, data loss prevention (DLP), and encryption strategies (at rest, in transit, and in use) - across products and internal systems.
  • Partner with product and engineering to embed privacy-by-design principles, particularly for products handling customer identity and access data.
  • Own data protection impact assessments (DPIAs) for new products, features, and data processing activities.
  • Ensure alignment between data handling practices and regulatory requirements across all operating geographies (GDPR, Indias DPDP Act, and regional data protection laws).
  • Own data retention, anonymization, and cross-border data transfer policies - including standard contractual clauses (SCCs) and binding corporate rules where required.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for data protection authorities across jurisdictions.


6. Compliance, Risk Governance
  • Lead and maintain certifications such as ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 2 Type II, and regional regulatory requirements across operating geographies.
  • Build audit-ready evidence frameworks - automated where possible - to reduce certification overhead and audit preparation time.
  • Manage:
    • Risk assessments (enterprise + product) with quantified risk scoring.
    • Third-party and vendor risk programs with defined assessment cadence.
    • Software supply chain risk as part of the broader vendor and dependency risk posture.
    • Multi-country regulatory interactions and customer security reviews.


7. Customer Trust External Interface
  • Represent the company in security due diligence discussions with enterprise customers (CISOs, CIOs, Risk leaders) - with the understanding that as a security vendor, our own posture is scrutinized to a higher standard.
  • Own responses to:
    • Security questionnaires.
    • RFP/RFI security sections.
    • Regulatory inquiries.
  • Build a trust narrative that positions our internal security practices as proof of our product philosophy - we secure ourselves with the same tools we sell.
  • Contribute to sales enablement by reducing security-related friction in enterprise deal cycles across all 12 operating countries.


8. Incident Response Resilience
  • Define and operationalize incident response and crisis management frameworks with clear escalation paths and communication protocols.
  • Conduct regular:
    • Tabletop exercises with cross-functional participation.
    • Red team / blue team simulations (including AI-augmented adversary simulations).
  • Ensure alignment between cyber resilience and business continuity / disaster recovery planning.
  • Define and track incident response metrics - Mean Time to Detect (MTTD), Mean Time to Respond (MTTR), and Mean Time to Recover.


9. Security Culture Awareness
  • Build and run a security awareness program for 300+ employees across multiple countries - including phishing simulations, role-specific training, and onboarding security modules.
  • Establish a developer security champions program to distribute security ownership across engineering teams - especially critical in a company whose products are security tools.
  • Foster a culture where security is everyones responsibility, not a bottleneck or afterthought.

We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, were looking for passionate people to join our mission. If youre ready to help the worlds best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!

Principal Product Designer - Infrastructure

Your opportunity

As a Principal Product Designer on New Relics Infrastructure design team, youll set the design vision for how engineers understand and operate the systems underneath their applications - cloud environments, Kubernetes, hosts, network performance (including eBPF-based instrumentation), and databases, partnering directly with VP- and SVP-level engineering and product leadership to shape a roadmap with measurable business impact. Youll work across the US and India to turn dense infrastructure telemetry into interfaces that hold up when something is actually on fire.

We care more about how you think than what youve already shipped. This role is built for someone with genuine, demonstrated curiosity about how complex technical systems work - someone who has a track record of digging into unfamiliar domains, asking good questions of engineers, and building real fluency rather than treating the underlying technology as a black box. Direct observability experience is a plus, not a prerequisite. The expectation for this role is someone who generates the ideas required to solve a problem even when its ambiguous, and who leads through that complexity rather than waiting for someone else to define it.

Youll set craft and design-system standards across the Infrastructure design team, mentor senior and mid-level designers beyond a single direct pod, and be a visible design leader recognized by teams inside and outside the department as we evolve how we use AI in our own design workflow. This is a remote role based in India, working in close daily overlap with a US-based team.

What youll do

  • Infrastructure & complex data visualization: Design dashboards and visualizations that make cloud, Kubernetes, host, network, and database telemetry legible - reducing cognitive load for engineers troubleshooting under pressure.
  • System coherence & fail-safe UX: Champion coherence across the Infrastructure surface, designing interaction patterns that guide platform engineers and SREs safely through incident response and root-cause investigation.
  • Own the product vision: Lead the creation of new product vision for Infrastructure with a clear line to business revenue impact, serving as the primary design point of contact across product, engineering, and go-to-market.
  • Go deep on the technology: Build real fluency in the systems youre designing for - cloud architecture, container orchestration, network protocols, eBPF, database internals - through direct conversations with engineers, hands-on exploration, and a genuine appetite for the technical detail most designers skip.
  • User research: Plan and run interviews and usability testing with SREs, platform engineers, and DevOps practitioners to validate design direction and keep the roadmap grounded in how these users actually work.
  • AI-forward evolution: Partner with engineering and product to bring AI-assisted diagnostics and anomaly detection into the infrastructure experience, applying the same curiosity to new AI tooling that you bring to the underlying systems.
  • Team leadership & craft: Set the craft bar across Infrastructure design, mentor senior and mid-level designers, and represent the teams design perspective directly to VP and SVP stakeholders.
  • Design at scale: Drive large-scale, cross-team design initiatives within Infrastructure, and partner with principal designers across Product Platform and Growth & Monetization to keep the broader platform coherent as it expands.

This role requires

  • 12+ years of professional experience in product or UX design, with a portfolio showing complex, data-heavy B2B SaaS or enterprise work.
  • Demonstrated, innate curiosity about technology - evidence that youve taught yourself unfamiliar technical domains in past roles, not just applied design process to whatever was handed to you.
  • Experience designing for technical personas (software engineers, SREs, DevOps, platform engineers), or a clear, credible path to ramping into this audience quickly.
  • Real skill in user research: interviews, usability testing, and synthesis that changes product direction, not just validates it.
  • Advanced proficiency in Figma and experience building or contributing to component-based design systems at scale, including a demonstrated ability to design systems-level solutions rather than instance by instance.
  • Solid grasp of WCAG 2.1 AA and assistive technologies, with the ability to independently troubleshoot accessibility issues and mentor others on accessible design practices.
  • Ability to connect design work to business outcomes - mapping initiatives to KPIs/OKRs and making the case for design decisions in terms product and engineering partners respect, including a track record of tying design work to measurable revenue impact, not just usability metrics.
  • Strong written and verbal English, and comfort working with a distributed team across US and India time zones.
  • A track record operating independently across multiple teams in a complex environment, with real experience partnering directly with VP- or SVP-level stakeholders on strategic initiatives.
  • An external professional presence in the design community - conferences, writing, mentorship beyond New Relic - consistent with the seniority of this level.

Bonus points if you have

  • Direct experience in observability, infrastructure monitoring, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI), or adjacent developer-facing tooling.
  • Prior exposure to designing for AI-assisted or LLM-based tools, and comfort prototyping with AI-native tools (Figma AI, Cursor, Claude Code, etc.).
  • A working understanding of frontend fundamentals (HTML, CSS, React) that makes engineering handoff smoother.
  • Strong facilitation skills for cross-functional design sprints and workshops.

Business Goals

This hire addresses cognitive overload during infrastructure incident response - the gap between a high-level "somethings wrong" signal and the granular cloud, cluster, host, network, or database trace that explains why. As New Relics Infrastructure suite absorbs more surface area (AI-agent observability, expanding eBPF coverage, deeper database monitoring), we need a design leader who can set a portfolio-level vision for that complexity - one with a credible line to business revenue and adoption, not just a well-designed feature. The end goal is the same one driving the whole design org right now: bringing AI into the diagnostic workflow to cut customer mean-time-to-resolution.

What are the key milestones or business outcomes this person must deliver in Year 1 to be considered a successful hire

  1. Unify infrastructure workflows: audit and connect monitoring and mitigation pathways across cloud, Kubernetes, host, network, and database surfaces, establishing a portfolio-level design vision with measurable adoption and revenue impact, not just shared visual patterns.
  2. AI-assisted diagnostics: deliver initial UX architecture and human-in-the-loop interaction models for AI-assisted anomaly detection and root-cause analysis in Infrastructure.
  3. Process maturation: help standardize cross-functional design review between design, product, and engineering on complex telemetry pipelines (OpenTelemetry, eBPF-based instrumentation).
  4. Research cadence: stand up a continuous research loop with SREs and platform engineers to keep the roadmap grounded in real operating conditions, not assumptions.
  5. Executive partnership: build a working relationship with VP/SVP engineering and product leadership, and with peer principal designers across Product Platform and Growth & Monetization, so Infrastructure's design vision holds together with the rest of the platform.

Job Description
We are looking for a Sr Staff Software Engineer (IC5) to help build and evolve the foundational platform capabilities that power our products and engineering organization.
As a Sr Staff Engineer, you will own significant technical domains and critical platform capabilities, defining their architecture, technical direction, and roadmap. You will design and build highly reliable, performant, secure, and scalable platform building blocks that can be leveraged across multiple engineering teams.
This is an AI-native engineering role. You will use AI, LLMs, coding agents, and agentic development workflows as first-class engineering tools across the software development lifecycle-from understanding problems and designing solutions to implementation, testing, debugging, documentation, and operations. You will also help establish the engineering practices and platform capabilities required to build and operate AI-powered products at scale.
You will operate with a high degree of autonomy, driving months-long initiatives that span multiple teams and have complex technical dependencies. You will identify problems before they are assigned, challenge the status quo, and continuously improve the platform and how engineering teams build software.
Key Responsibilities Platform Architecture & Technical Ownership
  • Design, build, and evolve highly reliable, performant, secure, and scalable platform building blocks.
  • Own the technical direction and evolution of multiple platform areas.
  • Define and influence the platform teams technical roadmap in partnership with engineering and product leadership.
  • Lead architecture and design for complex distributed systems, services, APIs, and platform capabilities.
  • Evaluate architectural patterns, technologies, and tooling and make pragmatic decisions based on scalability, reliability, security, performance, and developer experience.
  • Establish reusable engineering patterns, standards, frameworks, and tooling that can be adopted across teams.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to simplify architecture, eliminate technical debt, and improve platform capabilities.
AI-Native Engineering
  • Treat AI as a first-class engineering capability across the software development lifecycle.
  • Use LLMs, coding agents, AI-assisted development environments, and agentic workflows to increase engineering velocity, quality, and effectiveness.
  • Apply AI across problem discovery, design, implementation, testing, debugging, code review, documentation, and operational troubleshooting.
  • Develop effective human-AI collaboration patterns and establish guardrails for AI-assisted engineering.
  • Evaluate emerging AI-native development tools and incorporate those that provide meaningful engineering leverage.
  • Help engineering teams evolve from traditional development practices toward AI-native software engineering.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive engineering activities and enable AI agents to independently execute well-defined engineering workflows.
AI Platform & Product Capabilities
  • Design and build platform capabilities that enable teams to integrate and operate AI-powered experiences at scale.
  • Lead technical design for LLM integrations, agent workflows, tool calling, RAG, orchestration, and related AI capabilities where applicable.
  • Establish reusable patterns for AI reliability, security, observability, evaluation, scalability, latency, and cost management.
  • Partner with product and engineering teams to identify opportunities where AI can meaningfully improve product capabilities or engineering workflows.
Cross-Team Technical Leadership
  • Partner within and across engineering teams to provide cross-cutting technical solutions.
  • Lead initiatives involving multiple teams, systems, and technical dependencies.
  • Consistently deliver deadline-sensitive work that is interdependent with other engineering teams.
  • Drive technical alignment across teams without requiring management escalation.
  • Resolve architectural conflicts, technical dependencies, and integration challenges.
  • Communicate complex engineering and architectural concepts clearly and concisely to engineers, product managers, and other cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Influence product and engineering roadmaps through strong technical judgment and demonstrated outcomes.
Continuous Improvement & Engineering Excellence
  • Challenge the status quo and continuously improve the platform, architecture, processes, and engineering practices.
  • Identify systemic problems proactively and drive them to resolution.
  • Improve platform reliability, performance, security, developer experience, and operational efficiency.
  • Introduce new tooling and standards that reduce engineering friction and increase developer productivity.
  • Regularly participate in and lead peer code reviews, engineering design reviews, architecture reviews, and technical discussions.
  • Establish and promote engineering best practices across teams.
Ownership, Execution & Mentorship
  • Operate independently on ambiguous, high-complexity problems with minimal direction.
  • Own initiatives from problem definition through architecture, execution, delivery, and adoption.
  • Anticipate risks and dependencies and proactively establish mitigation strategies.
  • Work effectively in a startup-paced environment with a high degree of ownership and accountability.
  • Mentor IC1-IC4 engineers and help raise the technical capabilities of the broader engineering organization.
  • Share knowledge, encourage experimentation, and foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement. Qualifications
Qualifications Required Qualifications
  • 11+ years of experience designing, building, shipping, and maintaining software products or platforms.
  • B.S./M.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or an equivalent technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and building reliable, scalable, performant, and secure platforms or distributed systems.
  • Experience building and integrating with API-based platforms, with a strong understanding of REST and other RPC-based systems.
  • Strong experience building and maintaining microservices using one or more of Python, Golang, Java, or C++.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture, distributed systems, service design, APIs, databases, observability, security, and reliability.
  • Demonstrated experience owning significant technical domains and influencing technical roadmaps.
  • Proven ability to lead complex, cross-team initiatives with significant technical dependencies.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently, identify problems proactively, and drive ambiguous projects to completion.
  • Ability to communicate complex engineering concepts concisely and clearly to both technical and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Strong experience participating in peer code reviews, engineering design reviews, and architecture discussions.

Engineering Governance & AIEnabled Development Practices

  • Act as a change facilitator, ensuring transformation initiatives are practical and sustainable.

  • Systems thinking with the ability to identify systemic delivery issues and improvement opportunities.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in fast-paced delivery environments.

AutoRABIT Profile

AutoRABIT is the leader in DevSecOps for SaaS platforms such as Salesforce. Its unique metadata-aware capability makes Release Management, Version Control, and Backup & Recovery complete, reliable, and effective. AutoRABIT’s highly scalable framework covers the entire DevSecOps cycle, which makes it the favourite platform for companies, especially large ones who require enterprise strength and robustness in their deployment environment. AutoRABIT increases the productivity and confidence of developers which makes it a critical tool for development teams, especially large ones with complex applications. AutoRABIT has institutional funding and is well positioned for growth. Headquartered in the CA, USA and with customers worldwide, AutoRABIT is a place for bringing your creativity to the most demanding SaaS marketplace.

Job Role
We are seeking a highly experienced Principal Engineer (IC6) to lead the design, architecture, and end-to-end delivery of large-scale, high-performance backend systems. This role requires deep expertise in system architecture, development, and cross-functional leadership, with significant influence across multiple teams and products.
As a Principal Engineer, you will operate at an organizational level, driving technical strategy, solving complex problems, and enabling teams to build scalable, reliable, and secure systems. You will partner with engineering, product, sales, support, and architecture teams to ensure alignment and successful execution of high-impact initiatives.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Own and drive end-to-end architecture and delivery of critical systems across multiple teams
  • Define and evolve microservices architecture, platform design, and engineering standards across the organization
  • Lead complex technical initiatives and POCs to de-risk solutions and guide strategic decisions
  • Act as a technical leader and decision-maker, driving alignment across engineering, product, sales, support, and architecture teams
  • Design and guide implementation of highly scalable, distributed systems with strong focus on reliability, performance, and security
  • Architect and optimize data systems (PostgreSQL) and drive cloud-native solutions on AWS/GCP
  • Establish and enforce best practices across CI/CD, DevSecOps, observability, security, and resiliency
  • Drive high engineering standards, including code quality, design patterns, API contracts, and reusable frameworks
  • Lead and participate in code reviews, ensuring maintainable, secure, and production-grade code across teams
  • Contribute hands-on by building critical components, POCs, and performance-sensitive systems.
  • Mentor and elevate engineers, acting as a force multiplier across teams
  • Identify technical risks, drive long-term scalability and platform improvements
  • Own and resolve ambiguous, high-impact, business-critical problems
  • Lead architectural reviews, governance, and cross-team delivery execution
  • Drive refactoring, testability, and debugging strategies to improve system quality and reliability.
  • Leverage AI-assisted development tools and LLMs to improve developer productivity, code quality, and engineering efficiency
  • Drive adoption of AI-driven and specification-based development practices, translating requirements into code, APIs, and test artifacts
  • Responsibility to adhere to set internal controls.
Experience and Desired Skills:
  • 16 - 20 years of experience in software engineering, with significant experience in architecture and large-scale system design, running production software, with at least the last several as the person accountable for a product's architecture, not just a component.
  • Proven track record of owning and delivering complex, distributed systems across multiple teams
  • Expert-level knowledge of:
    • Designing GraphQL APIs / Rest APIs at scale: schema evolution, auth directives, pagination, N+1 avoidance, subscriptions.
    • Microservices architecture
    • Designing background-job and scheduling systems: queues, locking, idempotency, fairness, failure recovery.
    • Application security depth: OAuth and SSO flows, JWT handling, CSP and security headers, secrets management, supply-chain hygiene.
  • Database: schema design for multi-tenant data, indexing, partitioning, views, query plans, migration strategy against live customer databases. Experience with Prisma or a comparable ORM and clear judgement about when to bypass it.
  • Production AWS: ECS or a comparable container platform, RDS, S3, ECR, IAM, and a CI/CD pipeline you have owned end to end. Docker and Compose in daily use.
  • Practical use of LLM APIs in a product, and daily use of AI-assisted coding tools with a clear view of where they help and where they mislead.
  • Strong hands-on ability to prototype, build POCs, and solve complex technical challenges.
  • Experience leading initiatives in Agile/Scrum environments.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with ability to drive alignment across diverse teams.
  • Strong ownership mindset with ability to operate effectively in ambiguous and high-pressure environments.
Nice To Have:
  • RedwoodJS or CedarJS, GraphQL Yoga, Envelop.
  • Prior working experience with MuleSoft Anypoint Platform, Azure Integration Services or other integration platforms.
  • Static analysis, SAST, OWASP and CWE, or compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001.
  • Model Context Protocol server design.
  • Redis, nginx, supervisord, Bitbucket Pipelines.
  • Built or hardened a multi-tenant SaaS product.
Key Skills:
  • Enterprise Architecture
  • Microservices
  • AWS/GCP
  • Distributed Systems
  • PostgreSQL
  • DevSecOps
  • Platform Engineering
  • Technical Strategy
  • AI/LLM Enablement
  • Bedrock/OpenAI Integration
  • Kubernetes
  • Architecture Governance
  • Cross-functional Technical Leadership
Education
  • Bachelor’s in computers or any related field.
Location: Bangalore (Remote)
Experience:
  • 16 - 20 Years Experience

Compensation: 75 - 90 LPA
Website: www.autorabit.com

  • Design and implement ServiceNow Event Management to correlate events from monitoring tools (e.g., Splunk, SolarWinds, Dynatrace).

  • Develop alert and incident correlation strategies to reduce noise and improve ITOM efficiency.

  • Define ITOM governance frameworks to ensure data accuracy, security, and compliance with IT policies.

  • Conduct regular audits of cloud resources and align them with enterprise governance and compliance requirements.
  1. Training & Documentation:
  • Provide guidance and training to technical staff on cloud discovery architecture, processes, and troubleshooting.
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, discovery runbooks, and operational support guides.

  • Define the Now Assist adoption roadmap for ITOM and ITAM, identifying high-value AI use cases and sequencing enablement across environments.
  • Implement Now Assist for ITOM capabilities, including AI-generated incident and alert summarisation, alert grouping insights, and guided remediation recommendations.
  • Enable Now Assist for ITAM use cases such as contract and entitlement summarisation, asset request assistance, and AI-supported licence optimisation insights.
  • Configure and govern the underlying AI platform components - Now Assist skills, skill kits, AI Search, and generative AI controllers - with appropriate role-based access.
  • Establish responsible-AI governance for Now Assist: data privacy, prompt and response quality review, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and measurement of deflection and productivity benefits.

We are hiring a Director of Engineering to lead and grow our engineering function in India. You will own how we build and ship the engineering process, the quality bar, delivery, and the team itself. Required
